How big a screen do I need for an outdoor movie?
It depends on the crowd and how far back people sit. Send the guest count and the space and we size the screen and the projector to match.
Can the movie start before it is fully dark?
The picture looks best after sunset. A brighter projector helps at dusk, and we plan the start time with you.
Tell us what power is on site and where it is. We plan cable runs and power with you before the date.
Can you add sound for speeches or music before the film?
Yes. The same speakers carry a microphone or music before the film, and we can add lighting and a small stage on the same quote.
Do you set up and take down?
Yes. We deliver, set up and test before dusk, a technician runs the film, and we pack everything away after.
